description: Reviewed geocoding corrections (hand-checked 2026-11-18). Each entry replaces the automatic queries for one asset with one reviewed query: a structured street query, or a free-text query that adds the district. 'streetName' (when given) must still match the result's road, and 'precision' fixes the reported precision. The geocode step fails if an override refers to an unknown asset or is not applied. Entries marked 'Please confirm' rest on a judgement the portfolio owner should check.
